note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Pixel-art cel outline and eyes are softened into blurred edges at 1:1; outline is not crisp, halos at the palette boundaries. Usage is null.
flags.fix: Re-run with hard-edged cel labels (no smoothing across label boundaries) or a nearest-based cel upscale with a 1-2 px sharpen on the outline only.

flags.problem: Silhouette is softened: the spikes grow a light halo and the body edge goes blurry at 1:1, so the crisp flat-graphic design of the original is lost.
flags.fix: Use a hard alpha cut-out (as lightpole does) instead of soft_up for the spikes, keeping the soft glow only in the body colour.

flags.problem: PROMISED LAND lettering edges are blurry at 1:1 (the SE glyphs look smeared), not crisp flat art.
flags.fix: Use a hard-edged alpha reconstruction for the text, or a sharper edge pass on the alpha channel only, keeping the exact ink colour (49,49,90).

flags.problem: LOW ALT letterforms and the box edge are soft at 1:1; the glow halo is kept, but the lettering reads blurred.
flags.fix: Keep the glow, but sharpen the glyph and box edges in the alpha so the text reads cleanly at 1:1.

flags.problem: Ringing and ghosting around the M strokes at fit size, bright blob artifacts at the top stroke ends, and a red/orange fringe at the bottom vertex. The letter reads correctly but the edges are not clean.
flags.fix: Re-run with a plain per-channel ibp without overshoot, clamp the output to the source min/max per cel, and remove the vertex fringe by constraining the colour of the bottom vertex to the original neighbourhood.
